# node-crowdsec

> Node.js client for the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI), with an HTTP bouncer/watcher middleware, detection scenarios and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Packages

- [crowdsec-client](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/packages/crowdsec-client/README.md): CrowdSec LAPI client for bouncers and watchers (decisions, alerts, allowlists, streams, TLS/mTLS).
- [crowdsec-http-middleware](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/packages/crowdsec-http-middleware/readme.md): HTTP middleware that checks each request's IP against CrowdSec decisions and exposes `req.decision`.
- [crowdsec-client-scenarios](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/packages/crowdsec-client-scenarios/readme.md): optional detection scenarios (X-Forwarded-For, allowlist, HTTP enrichment, MaxMind).
- [crowdsec-mcp](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/packages/crowdsec-mcp/README.md): Model Context Protocol server exposing decisions, alerts and allowlists to an LLM.

## Documentation

- [Guides and usage documentation](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/wiki): authentication, bouncer/watcher setup, performance notes.
- [API reference](https://thib3113.github.io/node-crowdsec/): generated Typedoc API documentation.
- [AI agent setup guide](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/docs/agent-setup-guide.md): configure the HTTP middleware with an AI agent.
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md): ADRs, including the bouncer decision store.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting.

## Examples

- [express-bouncer](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/tree/main/examples/express-bouncer): Express + bouncer (TypeScript, ESM).
- [express-bouncer-cjs](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/tree/main/examples/express-bouncer-cjs): the same example in CommonJS.
- [express-web-parser](https://github.com/thib3113/node-crowdsec/tree/main/examples/express-web-parser): watcher that reports bad user-agents.
